subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age/max-turn automatic rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving session state across automatic resets.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session boundaries
options.body: Keep this issue open as a requirement but implement it only as part of the broader #17217 session-boundary design.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron/context-pruning/manual reset mitigations and avoid adding new core session lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced daily reset policy and pre-compaction memory flush, so the product choice spans code paths he previously shaped.
